correctness.rationale: For every positive time the Jacobi product gives a positive, strictly radially decreasing circle heat kernel. Zero-mass Jordan decomposition reduces the circular BV operator norm to pairwise density separation with correct factor one-half. The two shifted densities change sign exactly at two arc bisectors; their half-L1 distance is an explicit interval integral strictly increasing with angular separation, uniquely maximized at the antipode. Equality forces singleton opposite Jordan supports. Differentiating the heat equation at the semicircle endpoints gives K'(t)<0; unique normers exclude multiplicative equality. Gaussian Mills and Fourier tails establish exact leading constants; the standard-library checker independently confirms representative normalization and asymptotics. Finite tests are not treated as infinite proofs.
